from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/56637/1_56637_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/56637_0_3b84b431/1_56637_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

# Fill only the specified answer_position cells.
# Each staffing cell references the driver need for its own day/column in row 5,
# so values update automatically when the row-5 staffing requirement changes.
target_ranges = ["B12:B110", "C12:C23", "D12:H18"]

for rng in target_ranges:
    for row in ws[rng]:
        for cell in row:
            col_letter = get_column_letter(cell.column)
            cell.value = f"={col_letter}$5"

# Ensure formulas recalculate when opened.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
